restricted_sources: SRC.TULSI and other Sanskrit Documents / Project Madurai files (permission-dependent)

rule.withheld: Any run of TWO OR MORE consecutive words matching a restricted verse, and any line from a restricted telling, is withheld from EVERY file in the handoff — the changelog included. It is replaced by source + locator.
rule.permitted: A single Sanskrit word used as a gloss (for example muhūrtam, saṃcoditau) is vocabulary of the ancient language, not a reproduction of a digitisation. Single words may travel.
rule.boundary: A run of two or more consecutive words from a restricted verse is withheld IF at least one word is distinctive — longer than three letters or carrying a diacritic. Two bare particles (hi te, na ca, sa me) are not a reproduction of anything and may occur in ordinary text. Legal review recommended on this boundary.
rule.dutt: Dutt 1891 text may travel with attribution; basis recorded, legal review recommended.

verified_by: contradictions.py checks every string in every file, INCLUDING forensic_changelog.json, against the full restricted index — not a phrase list.
